title: Port Perry Repair Café
location: Port Perry Legion Hall, 16 Water St, Port Perry
description: Bring your broken things — small appliances, clothing, bikes, electronics. Volunteer fixers will work with you to repair them for free. No appointment needed.

title: Scugog Shores Farmers Market — Season Opening
location: Scugog Memorial Public Library Parking Lot, Port Perry
description: Opening weekend of the summer market. Local growers, bakers, and makers. Cash and debit accepted at most vendors.

title: Tenant Know-Your-Rights Night
location: Blackstock Community Centre, 23 Baldwin St, Blackstock
description: A plain-language walk through the Residential Tenancies Act for Scugog renters. What landlords can and can't do, how to respond to N-forms, and where to get help. Free and open to all.

title: Nestleton Community Garden — Work Bee
description: Seasonal work bee — weeding, bed prep, and shared harvest. New plot holders welcome. Bring gloves and a water bottle.
recurring: First Sunday of the month, June–September

title: Scugog Seed & Plant Swap
location: Prince Albert Community Hall, Prince Albert
description: Bring seeds, seedlings, cuttings, or bulbs — take what you need. Heirloom varieties especially welcome. Free coffee and conversation.

title: Co-op Information Night — Is a Co-op Right for Us?
location: Port Perry Public Library, 247 Queen St, Port Perry
description: An open conversation for anyone curious about starting or joining a co-operative in Scugog — food buying co-ops, housing co-ops, worker co-ops. Facilitated by a member of Co-operatives and Mutuals Canada.
